deterministic_agreement.meaning: These fields are fully determined by the SNP set, annotation and LD reference. Identity proves the two runs analysed the same data.

stochastic_agreement.cause: MAGMA estimates gene p-values by adaptive permutation where the analytic approximation is inadequate, i.e. for strongly associated genes. Two correct runs differ there and nowhere else.

monte_carlo_instability.consequence: Any top-N list cut at this threshold inherits this instability. Genes near the boundary are not stably ranked, and the tournament marks them rather than presenting the cut as exact.

what_this_does_and_does_not_establish: Establishes that the gene statistics follow from the stated inputs and method, re-derived here from the raw summary statistics with an independently built p-value file. Establishes nothing about whether Davies 2018 is the right GWAS, whether 10 kb is the right window, or whether any of these genes is causal for cognition.
